title: sdd-2.2-UTF-8-stdin
description: Add `-` as stdin with strict UTF-8 and process-owned stream lifetime. Depends on 2.1 so both formats compose with both sources. Exit: piped text, empty input, BOM modes, mixed newlines, malformed bytes, stdin read failures, JSON composition, and retained named-file behavior are verified. Full nonempty discovery, documentation and extracted-source module smoke checks complete the phase. Integrate by an explicit two-parent merge only at the full phase exit and verify/push main.
